author: Hacksmith Industries
description:
We buried a time capsule under our giant Thor hammer ⚡ Celebrate 20 years of ROG with us and check out the anniversary gear: https://ca.rog.gg/HacksmithROG20th

We built a custom time capsule to be buried for the next two decades.

We are sealing a collection of random items, including a GoPro and Minecraft memorabilia, inside a protective Thor hammer casing. See if this DIY project can survive being buried as a piece of buried treasure for future generations to find.

Subscribe for more wild engineering feats and Hacksmith build updates.
